Question 4

Consider the partition of the rectangular region R shown above and the positive function f(x,y) defined on R. Which of the following gives an expression for the lower Riemann sum of f with respect to this partition.

Hint: mij denotes the minimum value of f on the subregion Rij

a
2m11−m12−m13
b
m11+m12+m13
c
3(m11+m12+m13)
d
2⋅m11⋅m12⋅m13
e
2(m11+m12+m13)
